color.$description: Light-mode semantic color roles — aliases onto primitive ramps. Dark mode lives in color.dark.tokens.json; mode-independent colors in color.fixed.tokens.json. primary/secondary/tertiary are ACCENT ROLES: neutral by default, re-pointable by a consuming application (DESIGN.md section 2). the foundation primary/secondary 400 step was #b6b6b6 whereas neutral.400 is #ababab, so aliasing onto neutral shifts that one step — accepted divergence rather than inventing a new ramp.

primary.$description: Accent role. Neutral by default; a consuming application may re-point it to introduce its own accent. Overriding it must reach every component that binds it, without touching a call site.

secondary.$description: Accent role. Neutral by default and overridable independently of primary — an application may re-point only this one.

tertiary.$description: Accent role. Neutral by default and overridable independently of the other accent roles.
